info.title: reChess API
info.description: JSON API of the reChess shop. Request bodies are generated from the zod schemas of the routes; response shapes are described in words.

get.summary: Products with colours, prices and photos
Everything the site build needs in one response

post.summary: Add a product to the cart

200.description: Updated cart view; sets the visitor cookie on first use

patch.summary: Change the quantity of a cart line (0 removes it)

get.summary: Checkout data from the previous order
Delivery options for the cart and a city

post.summary: Place an order from the cart
Retry the payment of an order
Payment notification from a provider (the stub page sends it too)
Sign in; sets the session cookie
